name: Javier Ramirez
bio:
Javier's motorsport journey began in Santiago, tinkering with go-karts in his uncle's workshop. This hands-on experience sparked a passion that led him to pursue a degree in engineering. After graduating, he worked his way through various roles in smaller racing teams, from data analysis to pit crew coordination, always absorbing knowledge and honing his management skills. He believes in a data-driven approach, but understands the human element is crucial for peak performance. Javier’s ability to foster a collaborative environment, combined with his meticulous planning, sets him apart. He's known for his calm demeanor even under intense pressure, ensuring the team stays focused and efficient.

His work ethic and dedication to improving Caterham’s performance are unmatched. Javier is always looking for marginal gains, whether it's through refining pit stop strategies or optimizing car setup. His aim is to consistently punch above Caterham's weight, pushing them up the grid with smart decisions and effective team leadership. He sees the role of Sporting Director as a constant balancing act, managing the interplay between technical innovation, driver performance, and strategic race execution.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Javier has a focused gaze and a lean build, suggesting a disciplined lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a pre-race ritual of listening to classical music to stay calm.
Insists on team debriefs being conducted with everyone standing to maintain energy.
